# CloseTCPStream <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CloseTCPStream:Void tcp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tcp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to close. |

## Description

Closes a TCP stream. The other side sees the stream end once it has read everything that was sent.
